title.zh: Circle's $400M Tazapay deal buys emerging market links that take ‘years to build’
title.en: Circle's $400M Tazapay deal buys emerging market links that take ‘years to build’

current_state.zh: Circle is acquiring cross-border payments firm Tazapay for $400 million to gain emerging-market payment links and licensing that would otherwise take years to build, strengthening USDC's real-world payment infrastructure.
current_state.en: Circle is acquiring cross-border payments firm Tazapay for $400 million to gain emerging-market payment links and licensing that would otherwise take years to build, strengthening USDC's real-world payment infrastructure.
